## Products (https://www.11startups.tech/products)

### CodeReportCard
- **What**: a zero-config code quality report card for React, JavaScript and TypeScript projects. It scores a codebase 0–100 across five categories and prints an overall grade, with an optional summary "roast".
- **Where**: npm package `codereportcard` (https://www.npmjs.com/package/codereportcard), source at https://github.com/AshutoshMore142k4/codereportcard
- **Requirements**: Node.js 18 or later. MIT licensed.
- **Adoption**: 324+ npm downloads.

### Pebble mk1 (100k Params)
- **What**: a tiny Qwen-style language model (about 100k parameters) that you build and train from scratch on your own CPU, entirely in the browser, then chat with.
- **Link**: https://how-llms-work.scalable-api-free.workers.dev/chatbot (the app itself is titled "How LLMs Work").
- **Details**: no install and no GPU required. The first chat message trains the model, which takes about a minute. Temperature, top-p, training epochs and thread count are adjustable. The lessons run from a pattern-matching chat through tokenizer, embeddings, a XOR neural net, softmax and a full transformer.

### GrindSDE
- **What**: the NeetCode 150 and Striver's SDE Sheet in one place — 341 problems with C++ solutions, organized by pattern and difficulty.
- **Link**: https://grindsde.app/
- **Includes**: pattern templates, a LeetCode-to-pattern mapper, side-by-side algorithm comparisons, a system design section and a cheatsheet.

## Documentation (https://www.11startups.tech/docs)

### CodeReportCard quick start

```bash
# Run without installing
npx codereportcard .

# Or install globally
npm install -g codereportcard
codereportcard ./my-project
```

### CodeReportCard flags

| Command / flag | What it does |
|---|---|
| `codereportcard <path>` | Scan a project (use `.` for the current directory) |
| `--json` | JSON output (for CI/CD) |
| `--verbose` | Per-file issue breakdown |
| `--share` | Export a shareable PNG report card |
| `--share --output report.png` | Custom PNG output path |
| `--no-roast` | Disable the summary roast |
| `--fail-under <n>` | CI mode — exit with code 1 if the score is below the threshold |
| `--diff <branch>` | Only scan files changed vs a branch |
| `--staged` | Only scan staged files (pre-commit hook) |
| `init` | Generate a config file |

`--fix` (auto-fix) is listed in the README as coming soon.

### CodeReportCard scoring

Five categories — Clarity, Duplication, Dead Code, Secrets and AI Slop — weighted equally at 20% by default; change the balance with `weights` in the config.

### CodeReportCard configuration

Run `codereportcard init` to generate a config. It is read from `vibecheck.config.js` or `vibecheck.config.mjs`, `.vibecheckrc.json`, or a `"vibecheck"` key in `package.json`. Options: `exclude` (glob patterns), `rules` (per-rule `limit` and `severity`), `thresholds` (per-category minimum scores), `failUnder` (overall minimum; exit code 1 if below) and `weights` (category weights, auto-normalized to sum to 1.0).

### CodeReportCard in CI and pre-commit

```yaml
# .github/workflows/code-quality.yml
name: Code quality
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  report-card:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - run: npx codereportcard . --fail-under 75 --json
```

Pre-commit (for example with husky): `npx codereportcard . --staged --fail-under 70`

## Consulting services (https://www.11startups.tech/services)

### 1. AI Strategy Consulting
Audit operations, identify high-impact AI use cases, build a prioritised roadmap. Deliverables: AI readiness assessment, opportunity mapping and ROI analysis, technology stack recommendations, executive-ready implementation roadmap.

### 2. Rapid Prototyping
Go from concept to a working AI prototype in 2–4 weeks. Deliverables: working prototype, iterative feedback loops, risk-free concept validation, handoff to production.

### 3. Workflow Automation
Intelligent agents that learn processes and handle repetitive tasks such as document processing and customer routing. Deliverables: custom AI agent development, document and data extraction, intelligent task routing, continuous process optimisation.

### 4. Data Analytics & Insights
Advanced ML pipelines and dashboards that surface hidden patterns. Deliverables: custom ML models, real-time analytics dashboards, predictive forecasting, natural language querying.

### 5. AI Safety & Compliance
Governance frameworks and bias auditing. Deliverables: bias and fairness auditing, regulatory compliance support (EU AI Act and others), model explainability reports, AI ethics governance playbook.

### 6. Ongoing Support & Optimisation
Monitoring, fine-tuning and scaling of solutions after launch. Deliverables: monitoring and alerting, model retraining and drift detection, performance optimisation sprints; 24/7 SLA on the Scale plan.

### Platform capabilities
Multi-cloud deployment (AWS, Azure, GCP); modular architecture; security-first design (end-to-end encryption, access controls, audit logging); real-time monitoring of accuracy, latency and drift; custom AI agents; continuous learning through automatic retraining.

### Process
1. Discovery — business, data and goals. 2. Design — models, data pipelines, integrations. 3. Build — develop, test and iterate with weekly demos; the aim is a working prototype in under 4 weeks. 4. Deploy & Scale — production launch with monitoring and a scaling plan.

## Pricing (https://www.11startups.tech/#pricing)

Monthly or yearly billing, in USD or INR (INR includes 18% GST). Yearly billing is 10× the monthly rate (2 months free). AI usage — model API tokens, inference and compute — is billed directly to the client's own provider accounts and is not marked up.

| Plan | Monthly (USD) | Monthly (INR, incl. GST) | Includes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Starter | $599 | ₹45,000 | AI readiness assessment, 1 consultation/month, email support, basic workflow analysis, implementation roadmap |
| Growth (most popular) | $1,799 | ₹1,35,000 | Everything in Starter plus 4 consultations/month, custom AI model prototyping, priority support, dedicated AI engineer, monthly performance reports |
| Scale | $4,499 | ₹3,50,000 | Everything in Growth plus unlimited consultations, on-site workshops, AI safety and compliance audit, custom model training, 24/7 dedicated support |

## Frequently asked questions (https://www.11startups.tech/support)

**How do I get started?** Book a free consultation at https://cal.com/ash-28uynq/30min or email founder.ashutoshm@11startups.tech. We schedule a call to understand your needs and propose an approach.

**What industries do you serve?** Fintech, healthcare, e-commerce, logistics, SaaS and more; solutions are tailored to each sector.

**How long does a typical project take?** A proof of concept or prototype typically takes 2–4 weeks; a full production implementation can take 2–3 months. Detailed timelines are given in the initial consultation.

**Do you offer ongoing support after launch?** Yes — dedicated support and maintenance plans covering monitoring, updates and iterative improvements.

**What is your pricing model?** Monthly and yearly plans in USD or INR (see Pricing above). AI usage is billed directly to your own provider accounts.

**Can I cancel or change my plan?** Yes — upgrade, downgrade or cancel at any time, with no hidden fees or long-term lock-ins.
